components.name: Tall spruce
components.function: Distinct ordinary evergreen forms absent from new oak/birch/beech/hazel kit. Spruce conical needles, fir tiered boughs, pine raised irregular umbrella crown; saplings one coherent tree each, not duplicate adultgarden trees.
components.construction: One isolated tall spruce. Distinct ordinary evergreen forms absent from new oak/birch/beech/hazel kit. Spruce conical needles, fir tiered boughs, pine raised irregular umbrella crown; saplings one coherent tree each, not duplicate adultgarden trees. Coherent actual silhouette, visible root/underside/side; no unrelated architecture/scenery attached. Other existing named species/forms must not be regenerated. Local material consistent with source. Dimensions are proposals to refine by subject.
components.attachment_face: Underside/root to ground or declared host; keep true openings clear
components.semantic_front: Main visible face +Y and Zup; sides are actual thickness, not flattened painting
components.design_basis: Visible source vocabulary with missing construction views or new habitat forms; metrics and hidden surfaces proposed
components.notes: Four groups visible. Young group contains three tree forms at10/8/6m while heading says16m; use10m proposed group envelope and resolve labels before model intake. Scots pine is a taller forest form inspired by original coastal pine, not a new biology validation. Source backs, dimensions, repeat patterns, inter-view parity and physical attachment remain unverified. Whole-sheet generation does not prove individual meshes are separable.
